where: Signal: WHO El Niño health response
text: WHO is responding to El Niño's health risks at Grade 3, its highest emergency grade, under a plan for October 2026 to September 2027.

sources.label: World Health Organization: WHO Global Preparedness and Response to El Niño-Related Public Health Risks and Emergencies - Strategic Preparedness and Response Plan, 2026
